excerpts.text: As a locally owned and operated agency, we are invested in the communities we serve. Helping our neighborhood seniors continue to live in the comfort of their own homes is our primary goal. With **[senior care](https://www.visitingangels.com/jerseycity/about-us)** services from Visiting Angels of Jersey City, your loved one will also receive assistance from a compassionate and respectful caregiver.

If you have an aging parent who enjoys living at home, elder care assistance from Visiting Angels of Jersey City can help support them in their desire to remain independent. You don’t have to let daily tasks, such as household organization, meal planning, and dressing, keep a loved one from living the lifestyle they enjoy.

You can choose to receive care from Visiting Angels of Jersey City on a temporary or long-term basis. Care is available morning, noon, and night up to and including 24 hours around-the-clock care. We also have assistance available on holidays and weekends for those in need. Your flexible senior care plan from Visiting Angels of Jersey City can be altered if your needs change due to travel, illness, or other circumstances.
